name: postgis_cuda
abstract: GPU (CUDA, Hopper) spatial joins for PostGIS data, served by a resident-layer daemon
description: ST_Intersects, ST_Area(ST_Intersection), ST_Relate, point in polygon, ST_ClusterIntersecting, ST_DWithin(geography) and intersects of negative geography buffers on layers held in GPU memory by the gpujoind daemon, validated pair for pair against PostGIS 3.6. The gpu_spatial extension is a thin client; gpujoind is built and run separately on a Hopper GPU (see README).

gpu_spatial.abstract: Postgres client for the gpujoind GPU spatial join daemon
